outline: 課程主要為介紹機器學習基本原理和應用，學習DNN/CNN/LSTM/transformer的神經網路架構和各種機器學習方法，以及資通訊技術應用實務
schedule:
1. Introduction
2. DNN with labs
case study: OFDMA/NOMA resource allocaion (無線多媒體通訊應用)
3. Learning method with labs (AI玩遊戲)
4. CNN and object detection (Computer Vision電腦視覺)
5. RNN LSTM with lab
6. Analogizers: K-means, kNN, SVM
7. transformer (GAI/LLM)
case study: scene boundary detection (電腦視覺應用)
8. (optional) Naïve Bayes classifier(AI判斷貸款會違約嗎)
9. (optional) Symbolists: Decision Tree (AI判斷貸款會違約嗎)
10. Autodecoder (AI影像去雜訊/著色) with labs
11. Deep Reinforcement Learning (AlphaGo下圍棋勝世界冠軍，OpenAI Five玩Dota 2勝世界冠軍)
case study STAR-RIS DRL (無線多媒體通訊，行動邊緣運算應用)(optional)
case study GNN DRL (無線多媒體通訊應用)(optional)
case study UAV DRL (無線多媒體通訊應用)(optional)
case study UAV DRL practical video transmission PSNR decoder (無線多媒體通訊應用)(optional)
scorePolicy:
Oral report : 35%
